summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as three keyword-based ECS rules (ServiceNetworkConfiguration, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc, ServiceFargate) under src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/, with three matching test modules under test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. All 72 ECS tests pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src on the reference venv. The full unit suite gives 1530 passed and 1 failed: test_build_graph needs pygraphviz/pydot, which the venv lacks. The formatters test module cannot be collected because defusedxml is missing. Both are environmental; I did not install anything. No black or ruff was available, so I checked the 88-column limit by hand. Nothing is committed. Fixture artifact generic.yaml.dot created by the test run was removed.
